items.name: AI-Input-Basic
items.title: AI Input — Basic
items.description: A clean, minimal AI chat input component for React. Supports message submission, keyboard shortcuts, and seamless integration with any LLM-powered interface.

items.name: AI-Input-pill
items.title: AI Input — Pill
items.description: A pill-shaped AI chat input with a compact, modern aesthetic. Ideal for floating chat widgets, assistant overlays, and conversational UI layouts.

items.name: AI-Input-compact
items.title: AI Input — Compact
items.description: A space-efficient AI chat input designed for sidebars, panels, and tight layouts. Retains full functionality in a minimal footprint.

items.name: TypeWriterEffect
items.title: Typewriter Effect
items.description: A smooth, customizable typewriter text animation component for React. Built with Motion for fluid character-by-character reveals — perfect for hero headlines, AI responses, and onboarding flows.

items.name: Buttons
items.title: Animated Buttons
items.description: A collection of animated, production-ready button components for React. Includes hover effects, press states, and smooth Motion-powered transitions for modern UI design systems.

items.name: BentoHoverEffect
items.title: Bento Hover Effect
items.description: An interactive hover effect component for bento grid layouts. Uses Motion to animate scale, glow, and depth on mouse enter — ideal for feature showcases and dashboard landing pages.

items.name: AnimatedMenubar
items.title: Animated Menubar
items.description: A fully animated React menubar with smooth dropdown transitions powered by Motion. Features staggered menu item reveals, hover states, and accessible keyboard navigation.

items.name: HoverDepthCard
items.title: Hover Depth Card
items.description: A 3D perspective card component with mouse-tracked depth motion, tilt transforms, and dark mode support. Built with Motion — perfect for product previews, profile cards, and interactive feature highlights.

items.name: SpotlightCard
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A React card component with a radial gradient spotlight that tracks the mouse cursor in real time. Adds subtle depth and interactivity to pricing cards, feature grids, and content sections.

items.name: SpotlightCardBorderGlow
items.title: Spotlight Card — Border Glow
items.description: A spotlight card variant with a glowing animated border that follows the cursor. Combines a radial gradient fill with a luminous edge effect for a premium, glass-like card aesthetic.

items.name: SpotlightCardAnimatedBorder
items.title: Spotlight Card — Animated Border
items.description: A spotlight card with a continuously animated border stroke. Pairs cursor-tracking radial gradients with looping border motion for standout UI elements in dark-mode dashboards and landing pages.

items.name: Navigation_01
items.title: Navigation Bar 01
items.description: A responsive animated React navbar with expandable dropdown menus, scroll-aware shrinking, staggered entrance animations, and glassmorphic styling. Built with Motion and Tabler Icons.

items.name: Navigation_02
items.title: Navigation Bar 02
items.description: A scroll-aware animated navbar with glassmorphic design, staggered link animations, and expandable dropdown menus. An alternative layout to Navigation 01 with distinct spacing and visual hierarchy.

items.name: Navigation_03
items.title: Navigation Bar 03
items.description: A responsive React navbar with a Motion layout hover pill indicator, full-screen mobile drawer, body scroll lock, and backdrop blur. Smooth and accessible across all screen sizes.

items.name: FeaturesSection_01
items.title: Features Section 01
items.description: A responsive animated features section for React landing pages. Includes animated SVG icons, staggered reveal animations, and a glassmorphic card grid — ideal for showcasing product capabilities.

items.name: HeroSection_01
items.title: Hero Section 01
items.description: A full-page marketing hero block for React apps. Includes an integrated Navigation_03 navbar, animated headline, dual CTA buttons, and a framed dashboard preview image. Ready to drop into any landing page.

items.name: Contact_01
items.title: Contact Section 01
items.description: A minimal, accessible React contact form section for landing pages and SaaS sites. Includes name, email, and message fields with focus states, dark mode support, and a branded submit button — ready to wire to your API or form handler.

items.name: Inputs
items.title: Input Fields
items.description: A set of minimal, accessible React input components with clean focus states, label support, and dark mode compatibility. Designed to drop into any form or design system.

items.name: Commands
items.title: Command Components
items.description: Minimal, copy-ready CLI command display components for React documentation sites. Includes a single-command block and a multi-tab variant that switches between npm, pnpm, yarn, and bun install commands.
